content: {"action":"escalate","reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization, eligibility, or medical-necessity issue, so retro-authorization, peer-to-peer review, and a necessity appeal would not properly address it. Resubmitting without expert review risks a duplicate or another bundling denial, and the contractual balance cannot be shifted to the patient. A billing specialist must review the related paid service and payer bundling/edit rules to determine whether any coding correction or formal bundling challenge is valid."}
